question: The value of frac{{0.2 times 0.2 times 0.2 - 0.02 times 0.02 times 0.02}}{{2 times 2 times 2}} =
solution:
**Given:**

frac{{0.2 times 0.2 times 0.2 - 0.02 times 0.02 times 0.02}}{{2 times 2 times 2}}

**Concept used:**

Simple calculation is used here

**Calculation:**

⇒ frac{{0.2 times 0.2 times 0.2 - 0.02 times 0.02 times 0.02}}{{2 times 2 times 2}}

⇒ (0.008 - 0.000008)/(8)

⇒ (8(0.001-0.000001))/(8)

⇒ 0.001 - 0.000001

⇒ 0.000999
